title.en: Unit 5 Notes — Shear and Development Length
title.gu: યુનિટ 5 Notes — Shear અને Development Length

body.en:
Key points:

  • Transverse force produces shear stress; combined flexural and shear stresses can cause inclined cracks.
  • For a rectangular beam use nominal shear stress τv = Vu/(bd), with factored shear at the applicable critical section.
  • Obtain τc from IS 456 Table 19 using concrete grade and tension steel percentage pt = 100Ast/(bd); apply permissible interpolation and applicable rules.
  • Compare τv with τc,max from Table 20. If τv exceeds τc,max, increase section or concrete grade rather than relying on extra stirrups alone.

Where τv exceeds τc, shear reinforcement resists the excess Vus = Vu − τcbd. Minimum shear reinforcement and code detailing apply even when calculated excess is small, subject to applicable exceptions. Near-support and concentrated-load provisions must be checked separately.
body.gu:
મુખ્ય મુદ્દા:

  • Transverse force થી shear stress ઉત્પન્ન થાય છે; flexural અને shear stresses સાથે મળીને inclined cracks પેદા કરી શકે છે.
  • Rectangular beam માટે લાગુ critical section પર factored shear વડે nominal shear stress τv = Vu/(bd) લો.
  • Concrete grade અને tension steel percentage pt = 100Ast/(bd) વડે IS 456 Table 19 થી τc મેળવો; મંજૂર interpolation અને લાગુ rules અનુસરો.
  • τv ને Table 20 ના τc,max સાથે સરખાવો. τv વધુ હોય તો ફક્ત વધારાના stirrups પર આધાર ન રાખતા section અથવા concrete grade વધારો.

જ્યાં τv, τc કરતાં વધુ હોય ત્યાં shear reinforcement, excess Vus = Vu − τcbd resist કરે છે. Calculated excess ઓછું હોય તોપણ લાગુ exceptions હેઠળ minimum shear reinforcement અને code detailing જરૂરી છે. Near-support અને concentrated-load provisions અલગ તપાસો.

h.en: 5.2 Types, strength and spacing of shear reinforcement
h.gu: 5.2 Shear reinforcement ના પ્રકારો, strength અને spacing

body.en:
Types and applications:

  • Vertical stirrups cross diagonal cracks and are commonly detailed as closed two-legged links in beams.
  • Inclined stirrups cross a crack at an angle; use the correct code expression and angle.
  • Bent-up main bars can contribute to shear resistance when properly anchored, but longitudinal flexural and support requirements still apply. Code limits on bent-up bar contribution must be observed.
  • A single-legged link and a two-legged link have different total shear area Asv: count only effective legs crossing the shear plane.

For vertical stirrups, Vus = 0.87fy Asv d/sv, subject to the code limit on design shear-reinforcement strength. IS 456 minimum shear reinforcement requires Asv/sv ≥ 0.4b/(0.87fy); the specified fy limit for shear reinforcement applies. Maximum spacing for vertical stirrups is the lesser of 0.75d and 300 mm; inclined-stirrup spacing follows its own rule. Take the smallest spacing required by strength, minimum reinforcement, maximum spacing and other applicable detailing.
body.gu:
પ્રકારો અને ઉપયોગ:

  • Vertical stirrups diagonal cracks ને પાર કરે છે અને beams માં સામાન્ય રીતે closed two-legged links તરીકે આપવામાં આવે છે.
  • Inclined stirrups crack ને ખૂણે પાર કરે છે; યોગ્ય code expression અને angle લો.
  • યોગ્ય anchorage ધરાવતા bent-up main bars shear resistance માં ફાળો આપી શકે, પણ longitudinal flexural અને support requirements પણ લાગુ છે. Bent-up bar contribution માટે code limits અનુસરો.
  • Single-legged અને two-legged link નું કુલ shear area Asv જુદું છે: shear plane પાર કરતી effective legs જ ગણો.

Vertical stirrups માટે Vus = 0.87fy Asv d/sv છે, shear-reinforcement strength પરની code limit હેઠળ. IS 456 minimum shear reinforcement મુજબ Asv/sv ≥ 0.4b/(0.87fy) છે; shear reinforcement માટે નિર્દિષ્ટ fy limit લાગુ છે. Vertical stirrups માટે maximum spacing 0.75d અને 300 mm માંથી ઓછી છે; inclined stirrups માટે અલગ rule છે. Strength, minimum reinforcement, maximum spacing અને અન્ય લાગુ detailing પ્રમાણે સૌથી ઓછી spacing લો.

body.en: Check one-way shear per metre width near the support using the relevant critical section and effective depth. IS 456 permits an enhancement factor k for design shear strength of slabs of total depth D, subject to clause 40.2.1.1 and Table 19; use the specified interpolation and limit. Check punching separately around concentrated reactions or columns where applicable. Slabs normally rely on concrete for shear; do not assume shear reinforcement is unnecessary without the check.
body.gu: Support પાસે સંબંધિત critical section અને effective depth વડે metre width દીઠ one-way shear તપાસો. IS 456 clause 40.2.1.1 અને Table 19 હેઠળ total depth D ધરાવતા slabs માટે design shear strength માં enhancement factor k મંજૂર છે; નિર્દિષ્ટ interpolation અને limit લો. Concentrated reactions અથવા columns આસપાસ લાગુ હોય ત્યાં punching અલગ તપાસો. Slabs સામાન્ય રીતે shear માટે concrete પર આધાર રાખે છે; check વગર shear reinforcement બિનજરૂરી માની ન લો.

body.en:
Development length Ld = φσs/(4τbd) is the embedded length needed to develop a bar stress σs through design bond stress τbd. For ultimate tension design σs is commonly 0.87fy. Use IS 456 Table 21 for plain bars in tension, increase bond stress by 60% for deformed bars and by a further 25% for bars in compression, when applicable. Bond values depend on concrete grade. Actual anchorages, bends, hooks, available straight length, critical sections and support conditions must comply with the code.

Do not confuse: Ld is not automatically the lap length, nor is every geometric bar length effective anchorage. Bar cutoff, support anchorage and lap rules must be checked independently.
body.gu:
Development length Ld = φσs/(4τbd) એ design bond stress τbd વડે bar stress σs વિકસાવવા જરૂરી embedded length છે. Ultimate tension design માં σs સામાન્ય રીતે 0.87fy છે. Tension માં plain bars માટે IS 456 Table 21 લો, લાગુ હોય ત્યારે deformed bars માટે bond stress 60% અને compression bars માટે વધુ 25% વધારો. Bond values concrete grade પર આધારિત છે. Actual anchorages, bends, hooks, ઉપલબ્ધ straight length, critical sections અને support conditions code મુજબ હોવાં જોઈએ.

ભેદ ધ્યાનમાં લો: Ld આપોઆપ lap length નથી અને દરેક geometric bar length effective anchorage નથી. Bar cutoff, support anchorage અને lap rules અલગ તપાસો.

title.gu: Numerical 5.1 — Vertical stirrup spacing ની ગણતરી

body.en:
Given: A beam has b = 250 mm, d = 450 mm, Vu = 150 kN, M20 concrete and Fe415 stirrups. At the critical section assume Table 19 gives τc = 0.62 MPa and Table 20 gives τc,max = 2.8 MPa. Design two-legged 8 mm vertical stirrups.

Step 1. Check nominal and maximum shear stress.

τv = Vu / (bd)τv = 150000 / (250 × 450)τv ≈ 1.333 MPaτv < τc,max = 2.8 MPa

Step 2. Calculate the shear to be carried by stirrups.

Vc = τc b dVc = 0.62 × 250 × 450Vc = 69750 NVus = 150000 − 69750Vus = 80250 N

Step 3. Find the stirrup area and strength spacing.

Asv = 2 × π × 8² / 4Asv ≈ 100.53 mm²sv = 0.87fy Asv d / Vussv = 0.87 × 415 × 100.53 × 450 / 80250sv ≈ 203.5 mm

Step 4. Check minimum steel and maximum spacing.

sv,min steel = 0.87fy Asv / (0.4b)sv,min steel ≈ 363 mmsv,max = min(0.75d, 300)sv,max = min(337.5, 300)sv,max = 300 mm

Final answer:

Provide two-legged 8 mm stirrups at 200 mm centres in this zone; check full beam detailing and other critical sections.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: Beam માટે b = 250 mm, d = 450 mm, Vu = 150 kN, M20 concrete અને Fe415 stirrups છે. Critical section પર Table 19 મુજબ τc = 0.62 MPa અને Table 20 મુજબ τc,max = 2.8 MPa ધારો. Two-legged 8 mm vertical stirrups design કરો.

Step 1. Nominal અને maximum shear stress તપાસો.

τv = Vu / (bd)τv = 150000 / (250 × 450)τv ≈ 1.333 MPaτv < τc,max = 2.8 MPa

Step 2. Stirrups દ્વારા લેવાતો shear ગણો.

Vc = τc b dVc = 0.62 × 250 × 450Vc = 69750 NVus = 150000 − 69750Vus = 80250 N

Step 3. Stirrup area અને strength spacing શોધો.

Asv = 2 × π × 8² / 4Asv ≈ 100.53 mm²sv = 0.87fy Asv d / Vussv = 0.87 × 415 × 100.53 × 450 / 80250sv ≈ 203.5 mm

Step 4. Minimum steel અને maximum spacing તપાસો.

sv,min steel = 0.87fy Asv / (0.4b)sv,min steel ≈ 363 mmsv,max = min(0.75d, 300)sv,max = min(337.5, 300)sv,max = 300 mm

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આ zone માં two-legged 8 mm stirrups 200 mm centres પર આપો; સંપૂર્ણ beam detailing અને અન્ય critical sections તપાસો.

title.en: Numerical 5.2 — Development length in tension and compression
title.gu: Numerical 5.2 — Tension અને compression માં development length

body.en:
Given: Find Ld for a 16 mm Fe415 deformed bar in M20 concrete at design stress 0.87fy. Use Table 21 plain-bar tension bond stress 1.2 MPa and applicable increases of 60% for deformed bars and 25% for compression.

Step 1. Calculate design bar stress and tension bond stress.

σs = 0.87 × 415σs = 361.05 MPaτbd,tension = 1.2 × 1.60τbd,tension = 1.92 MPa

Step 2. Find tension development length.

Ld,tension = φσs / (4τbd)Ld,tension = 16 × 361.05 / (4 × 1.92)Ld,tension ≈ 752.19 mm

Step 3. Calculate compression bond stress and development length.

τbd,compression = 1.92 × 1.25τbd,compression = 2.40 MPaLd,compression = 16 × 361.05 / (4 × 2.40)Ld,compression ≈ 601.75 mm

Final answer:

Required Ld is approximately 752 mm in tension and 602 mm in compression under these assumptions.
body.gu:
આપેલ છે: M20 concrete માં 16 mm Fe415 deformed bar માટે design stress 0.87fy પર Ld શોધો. Table 21 માં plain-bar tension bond stress 1.2 MPa તથા લાગુ 60% deformed-bar અને 25% compression increases લો.

Step 1. Design bar stress અને tension bond stress ગણો.

σs = 0.87 × 415σs = 361.05 MPaτbd,tension = 1.2 × 1.60τbd,tension = 1.92 MPa

Step 2. Tension development length શોધો.

Ld,tension = φσs / (4τbd)Ld,tension = 16 × 361.05 / (4 × 1.92)Ld,tension ≈ 752.19 mm

Step 3. Compression bond stress અને development length ગણો.

τbd,compression = 1.92 × 1.25τbd,compression = 2.40 MPaLd,compression = 16 × 361.05 / (4 × 2.40)Ld,compression ≈ 601.75 mm

અંતિમ જવાબ:

આ assumptions હેઠળ જરૂરી Ld tension માં લગભગ 752 mm અને compression માં 602 mm છે.

q.gu: Shear force શું છે?

a.en: A transverse internal force on a section.

q.gu: Nominal shear stress શું છે?

a.en: Factored shear divided by b times effective depth.
a.gu: Factored shear ભાગ્યા b અને effective depth નો ગુણાકાર.

q.gu: τc શું છે?

a.en: Design shear strength of concrete under applicable conditions.
a.gu: લાગુ conditions હેઠળ concrete ની design shear strength.

q.gu: τc ક્યાંથી મળે?
τv, τc,max કરતાં વધુ હોય તો શું કરવું?

a.en: Increase section or concrete grade and redesign.
a.gu: Section અથવા concrete grade વધારી redesign કરો.

q.gu: Asv શું છે?

a.gu: Effective stirrup legs નો કુલ area.

q.gu: Two-legged stirrup શું છે?

a.en: A link with two effective shear-resisting legs.
a.gu: Shear resist કરતી બે effective legs ધરાવતી link.

q.en: Why are stirrups closer near supports?
q.gu: Support પાસે stirrups નજીક કેમ હોય છે?

a.en: Shear is often higher near supports.
a.gu: Support પાસે shear ઘણી વાર વધુ હોય છે.

q.gu: Development length શું છે?

a.en: Length required to transfer bar force by bond.
a.gu: Bond દ્વારા bar force transfer કરવા જરૂરી length.

q.en: Does a deformed bar have enhanced bond?
q.gu: Deformed bar માં bond વધારે હોય છે?

a.en: Yes, by the applicable code factor.

q.en: Is development length identical to lap length?
q.gu: Development length અને lap length સમાન છે?

q.en: Does a slab need a shear check?
q.gu: Slab માટે shear check જરૂરી છે?

a.gu: હા, લાગુ હોય ત્યાં punching સહિત.

q.en: Explain shear behaviour and concrete shear strength of beams.
q.gu: Beams માં shear behaviour અને concrete shear strength સમજાવો.

q.en: Design vertical stirrups for a given factored shear.
q.gu: આપેલ factored shear માટે vertical stirrups design કરો.

q.en: Explain development length and calculate it for tension and compression bars.
q.gu: Development length સમજાવી tension અને compression bars માટે ગણો.

q.en: Discuss types of shear reinforcement and slab shear checks.
q.gu: Shear reinforcement ના પ્રકારો અને slab shear checks ચર્ચો.
Nominal shear stress વ્યાખ્યાયિત કરો.
Single અને two-legged stirrups સમજાવો.

q.en: State maximum spacing of vertical stirrups.
q.gu: Vertical stirrups ની maximum spacing લખો.
Bond અને anchorage સમજાવો.
